scope: Primary components of the five papers/modules linked in this project; not an exhaustive extraction of every study cited by REVIEW.
shiny_status: Link supplied by the project team. Live contents were not accessible to the research browser on 26 October 2026.

methods.name: REVIEW / evidence synthesis
methods.requirements: Study eligibility and source-level quality assessment

methods.name: Transcriptome-wide Mendelian randomisation (MR)
methods.inputs: GWAS, eQTL instruments and linkage information
methods.requirements: Instrument strength, pleiotropy and ancestry checks
methods.status: Method-support subset available; pipeline not connected

methods.name: Control Theory (CT)
methods.status: Method-support subset available; pipeline not connected

methods.name: Differential Causal Effects (DCE)
methods.inputs: Case/control molecular data and pathway definitions
methods.requirements: Feature selection and preprocessing must respect evaluation splits
methods.status: Method-support subset available; pipeline not connected

methods.name: ConC consensus clustering / subtype interpretation
methods.inputs: Candidate-gene expression profiles; symptoms for interpretation
methods.outputs: Exploratory molecular clusters and symptom profiles
methods.requirements: CancerSubtype ConC settings, stability and independent cohorts
methods.status: Published themes displayed; no patient classifier

methods.name: TACO / TabPFN-based prediction
methods.inputs: Selected molecular features and labelled reference cohort
methods.requirements: Resolve standalone versus ensemble definition, versions and calibration
methods.status: Evidence and metadata tools available; model not executed

methods.name: Causal-gene to drug-target mapping
methods.inputs: Candidate genes and pharmacological target databases
methods.requirements: Identifier mapping, direction and database versions
methods.status: Catalogue description only; outputs not imported

methods.name: PlaNet cohort prediction
methods.inputs: Candidate intervention and fixed trial-cohort context
methods.outputs: Modelled safety, adverse events and efficacy
methods.requirements: Cohort definition, endpoint meaning and model version
methods.status: Catalogue description only; model not executed

methods.name: SPLIT deprioritisation rules
methods.outputs: Composite, threshold and counterfactual-delta research flags
methods.requirements: Rule weights and thresholds; never equate with prescriptions
methods.status: Catalogue description only; scores not imported

methods.name: Paper2Agent / MCP orchestration
methods.inputs: Paper, code, tutorials and reference data
methods.requirements: Verify each scientific tool against reference outputs
methods.status: TACO evidence MCP server implemented; host connection separate

pipelines.name: MR + CT gene prioritisation
pipelines.description: Combine genetic and network evidence while preserving their different meanings.
pipelines.compatibility: Align gene identifiers and retain the published weighting / sensitivity settings.
pipelines.validation: Sensitivity analysis, instrument checks and independent replication

pipelines.name: Gene prioritisation → molecular subtyping
pipelines.description: Use candidate-gene expression to discover clusters, then interpret symptom profiles.
pipelines.compatibility: Gene-expression data are required; symptom checkboxes cannot replace the clustering inputs.
pipelines.validation: Cluster stability and independent subtype replication

pipelines.name: DCE features → TACO evaluation
pipelines.description: Compare selected molecular features in a TabPFN-based evaluation.
pipelines.compatibility: Confirm the exact model / ensemble and keep feature selection inside the evaluation design.
pipelines.validation: Participant-level held-out evaluation, calibration and external validation

pipelines.name: Causal methods → target mapping → drug predictions
pipelines.description: Combine gene evidence with drug targets and cohort-conditioned prediction / deprioritisation.
pipelines.compatibility: Gene overlap is not proof of drug benefit; cohort and endpoint definitions must match.
pipelines.validation: Target mapping audit and cohort-specific predictive validation

pipelines.name: Subtype-specific drug exploration
pipelines.description: Explore whether molecular subgroups support different drug hypotheses.
pipelines.compatibility: A molecular subtype is not automatically a PlaNet trial cohort; a mapping study is required.
pipelines.validation: Independent subtype assignment plus subgroup-specific outcome validation

pipelines.name: Combined causal, subtype, detection and drug workflow
pipelines.description: Plan an integrated research workflow across all four scientific tasks.
pipelines.compatibility: The tasks need separate cohorts, contracts, uncertainty measures and evaluation; no combined risk score is defined.
pipelines.validation: Validate each task first, then assess the full workflow on independent data

pipelines.name: Paper2Agent-style TACO assistant
pipelines.description: Connect source-grounded TACO tools to an MCP host for conversational access.
pipelines.compatibility: LLM connection and scientific model execution are separate milestones.
pipelines.validation: Tool contracts and MCP integration; scientific execution still pending

pipelines.name: All project modules: evidence → scientific tasks → orchestration
pipelines.description: Plan a combined workflow covering the core components from all five project modules.
pipelines.compatibility: Evidence synthesis supplies context, scientific tasks retain separate inputs and outputs, and MCP coordinates only verified functions. No combined scientific score is defined.
pipelines.validation: Task-specific reference reproduction, independent scientific validation and end-to-end orchestration checks
